description:
[Game reference] Monument puzzles: keycards, fuses, radiation and puzzle loot for every monument. One row per monument the game files have puzzle, radiation or bench data for: `cards` (keycard colours its doors
take), `fuse_boxes`, `doors` (number of puzzle doors), `rad` (highest radiation zone, rads/s before protection: you
need that much radiation protection to take none), `reset` (puzzle reset timer), `loot` (best things the puzzle
rooms respawn, with `max` per reset and `url`), `amenities` (recycler, research_table, repair_bench, workbench
levels). `rules`: fuse life, keycard swipes, radiation tiers, reset-radiation convars. Fetch one monument's full
route with `/monument-puzzles/{slug}`. Use card=red etc. for 'which monuments need a red card'. Link https://rust.wiki/monument-puzzles.

card.description: Only monuments with a door for this keycard.
